title: District Collector Can't Order Police To Recall Closure Report Or Reopen Probe: MP High Court
description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court has held that the District Collector cannot pass an executive mandate to the police authorities to recall the closure report or reopen the investigation into a criminal case. [2026 LiveLaw (MP) 284] The bench of Justice Jai Kumar Pillai further emphasized that such orders would amount to "allowing the executive to usurp the judicial function of a Magistrate".
